mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM account a INNER JOIN account_record ar ON ar.account_id = a.id WHERE a.user_id IN (#{groomId}, #{brideId}) AND ar.type = 'SAVING' )
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ar.amount), 0) FROM account a INNER JOIN account_record ar ON ar.account_id = a.id WHERE a.user_id IN (#{groomId}, #{brideId}) AND ar.type = 'SAVING'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.user_id = #{groomId} THEN ar.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS groomSavingAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.user_id = #{brideId} THEN ar.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS brideSavingAmount FROM account a INNER JOIN account_record ar ON ar.account_id = a.id WHERE a.user_id IN (#{groomId}, #{brideId}) AND ar.type = 'SAVING'

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ar.record_date, '%Y-%m') AS yearMonth, COALESCE(SUM(ar.amount), 0) AS savingAmount FROM account a INNER JOIN account_record ar ON ar.account_id = a.id WHERE a.user_id IN (#{groomId}, #{brideId}) AND ar.type = 'SAVING' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ar.record_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY MIN(ar.record_date) ASC
